observedHighlighting.actionDelimiters: Actions use the native brace color.
observedHighlighting.actionKeywords: define, if, range, with, else and end are highlighted as keywords.
observedHighlighting.builtins: printf is recognized separately as a template builtin.
observedHighlighting.variablesAndFields: Dollar variables and dotted fields are highlighted without treating surrounding HTML or text as Go source.
observedHighlighting.stringsAndPipes: Quoted strings and the pipeline operator are highlighted.
observedHighlighting.comments: Template comments are tokenized atomically when starting with {{/* after the action delimiter.

boundary: This proves native file associations, templates are not mapped to gopls, and lexical action highlighting works in a packaged application. Template execution, symbol completion inside templates, template-specific inspections, embedded Go semantic analysis, HTML/XML structure merging, and byte-for-byte GoLand runtime equivalence remain separate checks.
